Metadata.title: Sob Livraison — Fast delivery in Lomé
Metadata.description: Parcels, meals and groceries delivered across Lomé. Instant quote and cash on delivery.

Footer.tagline: Parcels, meals and groceries delivered fast across Lomé.
Footer.availability: Orders 7 days a week, any time

hero.eyebrow: Delivery in Lomé, 7 days a week
hero.title: Your parcels, meals and groceries delivered fast in Lomé
hero.subtitle: A clear price based on distance, a trusted courier, and you pay cash on delivery.

services.title: What we deliver
services.subtitle: One service for everything you need delivered across Lomé.

parcel.title: Parcels and documents
parcel.text: Packages, envelopes, important papers: picked up and handed over in person.

meal.title: Meals
meal.text: Your favourite dishes picked up at the restaurant and delivered still hot.

groceries.title: Groceries
groceries.text: Market or supermarket: we pick up your shopping and bring it to you.

steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: Three simple steps, from your phone.

step1.title: Tell us the route
step1.text: Give us the pick-up point, the drop-off point and the size of your item.

step2.title: Get your price
step2.text: The price is based on the road distance. No surprises.

step3.title: We handle the rest
step3.text: A courier picks up and delivers your item. You pay cash on delivery.

fast.title: Fast
fast.text: Usually delivered in 30 to 60 minutes, depending on distance.

price.title: Transparent pricing
price.text: Based on distance, starting from 500 FCFA.

cash.title: Cash on delivery
cash.text: You pay in cash once the delivery is done.

available.title: Available 7 days a week
available.text: Order any time, for immediate or scheduled delivery.

cta.title: Something to deliver?
cta.text: Message us on WhatsApp, we reply quickly.

ServicesPage.metaDescription: Parcel, meal and grocery delivery in Lomé. Distance-based pricing: 300 FCFA pick-up fee + 150 FCFA per km, minimum 500 FCFA.
ServicesPage.title: Our services and prices
ServicesPage.intro: Parcels, meals or groceries: we deliver across Greater Lomé, with a price based on the road distance.

parcel.title: Parcels and documents
parcel.text: Your items picked up and handed over in person to the recipient.

meal.title: Meals
meal.text: We pick up your order at the restaurant and bring it to you quickly.
meal.ex2: Home-made meals for a loved one

groceries.title: Groceries
groceries.text: We pick up your already-paid shopping and deliver it to you.

pricing.title: Our prices
pricing.intro: The price depends on the road distance between pick-up and drop-off. It is rounded up to the next 100 FCFA.
pricing.maxNote: Beyond 30 km, ask us for a quote on WhatsApp.

sizes.title: Item sizes
sizes.intro: The size of your item adds a small surcharge.

immediate.title: Immediate delivery
immediate.text: Estimated 30 to 60 minutes, depending on distance.

scheduled.title: Scheduled delivery
scheduled.text: Pick the date and time: at least 1 hour ahead, up to 7 days.

reachable.title: Stay reachable
reachable.text: You and the recipient must be reachable by phone during the delivery.
